author: Arnav
problem: A car park camera logs the plate of each car entering, in time order. Return the position in the log of the most recent entry by the given plate, or -1 if it never entered.
bug_description: The backwards loop is range(len(plates) - 1, 0, -1), which stops before index 0, so an entry at the start of the log is never found.

comments.accurate: Scans the log from the newest entry back for this plate, or -1 if it never entered
comments.wrong_behavior: Scans back through the log for this plate; the first line is the camera's start-up record
comments.wrong_location: Reverse scan verified; check the plate comparison and the -1 fallback
